verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Groq has written docs, markdown docs pages, an llms.txt, and SDK code snippets. None of it documents an interactive API reference or in-browser runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Static code snippets in docs and SDK READMEs are adjacent material, not an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
